incident.class: E1 metadata access exceeded the narrowly authorized identity-source scope
incident.authorized_source: sealed matched-panel manifest plus its seal manifest and firewall lock
incident.additional_access: During source discovery, file names were enumerated and SHA-256 hashes were computed for seven unrelated E1 extraction/provenance metadata files: two pass receipts, extraction-start receipt, extraction artifact hash tree, feature-cache repeat-parity receipt, E1 repair contract, and E1 repair seal receipt.
incident.content_interpretation: No semantic contents of those seven files were inspected or used; hashing nevertheless read their bytes and exceeded the authorization.
incident.denied_sources: No candidate join, candidate feature, raw target, prediction, metric, treatment result, geometry diagnostic, or head output was read during the v02 denylist extraction. The separate v01 E1-join incident remains recorded in v01-quarantine-receipt.json.

v02_artifacts_at_stop.denylist_output_disposition: preserve as provenance; do not promote pending user disposition

stop_rule: No further E1 access, panel generation, LFM loading, feature extraction, training, evaluation, or sealing/promotion of the v02 denylist chain pending explicit user disposition.
